source_rows.text: # Living Galaxy expansion architecture
Date: 2026-10-03. Status: **PROPOSED coordinated review submission2; independent integrated review, fresh complete vectors and human approval pending**.
Parent: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-01-sandbox-completion-and-expansion.md`.
## Product contract
Deliver autonomous societies with population needs, specialization and research;
deterministic evolving ecology; negotiated diplomacy and objective-driven
conflict. Include creator interventions, explanations, experiments, immutable
history, saves and portable reproduction for every subsystem. The creator is
omniscient and can override conditions/policies; autonomous actors only consume
their permitted observations. No player faction, mandatory victory or forced
terminal state is introduced.
This architecture specification is not approval of numerical rules. Focused
society, ecology and diplomacy specifications must define their exact formulas,
phase order, catalog/wire fields and independent vectors before code for those
mechanics is accepted. Existing V2 completion work remains authorized by its
approved contracts and proceeds separately.
## Version and authority isolation
Use **Living V3** for stateful expansion mechanics. Preserve V2 code, catalog,
wire/hash domains and archive interpretation. An old save always opens through
its matching engine. Do not append population/research/alliances/environmental
clocks to V2 canonical state, invent omitted-default V2 mechanics or change V2
replay based on an application setting.
Implement the new pure authority in a separate `nyon-living-core` workspace crate.
Its dependencies may use the already-approved serialization/hash/error libraries
but never the root application, wgpu, winit, Tokio, browser/storage APIs or the
Workshop/V2 authority. Reuse patterns and engine rendering rather than converting
legacy IDs or making V3 depend on a frozen V2 state machine.
Each domain owns its entity/branch/revision IDs, catalog hashes, state digests,
receipt digests, commands and archive types. Canonical domains include an explicit
V3 marker; the focused wire specification defines their literal bytes and ordered
fields before deriving expected vectors independently.
No migration is part of first delivery. V2 libraries remain visible and usable.
V3 starts from validated V3 content or a new V3 document. A later conversion tool
would create a separate new document, identify losses and retain the original;
it requires its own specification and authorization.
## Core execution and publication

The Proposed core schema now binds Actor32 source selection, decoder stages, optional minimal tick-zero profile, derived future-Truce account and exact history/Notebook operators. Scoring §Conditional private B/F operator defines private scenario dependencies and14 capacity accounts; unsupported outcomes never become authority evidence. Running acceptance stages its exact phase1 prefix Revision/capture and durable mark, while the complete Receipt seals only after queue plus later phases. Aggregate creator events report operation-order mutations; they are not an instruction stream. Historical counters/forks and Notebook ordinals follow schema, with no new command/queue/header fields. Public0/>1024 rejects invalid_range; internal exhausted0 continues.
One unpublished job owns a complete candidate and cumulative event facts.
Capture immutable authority inputs without deep copying. Copy/index/hash/phase
work, forecasts, validation, encoding and journal preparation share a bounded
record-visit budget. V3 also uses 1..=1024 visits per poll; returning Pending is
not permission to do an uncounted full-state traversal first.
Ecology §Boundary order defines twelve registered phases, its twelve phase2
subpasses and exact mixed P/R/B/O/H/K/M/F/A region. Phase11 validates/prepares;
phase12 seals/finalizes/publishes. Guarded phase5 costs precede phase6 needs. Phase7 captures each Active actor's permitted planning records once in actor-ID
order; Dormant receives no invented capture/audit. Phase8/9 share that immutable input and one central ledger; protected
category0 plans precede other material admissions and older pending offers.
Scoring §§1–8 fixes the200-boundary forecast, imminent<=100 gate, four categories,
policy weights, complete identity, force selection and stable merge/ties. Neither
negotiation nor reservations recapture/rescore the actor's proposed candidates.
Exact full candidate/audit declarations are in complete-schema's integrated sections.
ActorInputContext hashes only permitted planning context; outer full State/revision
provenance is authenticated separately through CandidateAudit/Receipt. The trace
contains eligible complete identities only; central attempted denial reasons have
a fixed separate first-failure order. Tagged economy/offer/war components preserve
exact explanations without inventing a generic utility bucket.
Original actor SnapshotReferences remain phase7 byte-for-byte on Decisions,
CandidateAudit and actor-owned fact/RecordProvenance snapshots. Execution8/9 and
AUTO producer phase are separate; no phase rewrap or recapture enriches intent.
One W/ledger executes actual category0 transactions before old pending Request
consideration/Offers/handshake/Peace. Final producer8/9 event buffers preserve each
logical subsequence and phase-monotone presentation; independent replay reconstructs
actual schedule/guards/issuance/holds first and compares those buffers, never applies
sorted Change witnesses as instructions. Late phase9 declaration release reports
its finalization but structurally owns the Fleet through actual phase10.
Physical account P is always real current inventory. Private cargo/payment H sums,
linked source floors B MAX-coalesce, H+B<=P. Stage8 physical checks precede stage9
actual competition; self entitlement never bypasses a structural asset lock. Actual
Fleet/Route dispatch consumes/releases self and preserves others with exact closed
carriers, no double debit, false stock shortage or persisted future escrow. All
nested owner/index/path/forecast/source/replay/hash/byte/output/cleanup visits share
the remaining public1–1024 budget; constructors/finish never hide full scans.
History authenticates semantic objective/C instances through real installation/
replacement operations, including equal-byte replacement. Terminal historical target
exceptions are position-specific and never license live paid endpoints. Next ordinary
Objective/Defense witness installation is pointer-only phase2; Supply is phase3.
Paused creator/save/fork preserves prior pointer and never consumes its own current
receipt. Creator transient empty Fleet context is derived within one batch and
fully closes before completed State; it is not a serialized capability/default.
Whole-final paid itinerary, immutable Shipment duration and Hull voyage origins
survive exact bounded archive/reference-retirement contracts; no current graph or
replacement identity repairs original payment evidence.
Prepared success/failure tokens have private constructors. Publication verifies
exact capture ownership, queue/revision cursor, allocator marks and resident
generation before moving owners. No fallible work or capacity-sized destruction
occurs inside that fence. Retired owners are reclaimed by a bounded queue.
Faults preserve the preceding valid state and accepted queue; ordinary invalid
submissions consume neither IDs nor resources. Cancellation never publishes a
private candidate.
Actor proposals use one immutable information-limited snapshot. Central
reservation decides conflicts in the specified stable order. Population, food,
energy, industry slots, route capacity, research funding and fleet assets cannot
be spent twice by economy, ecology adaptation and military plans. Own paid accounts
are physical local stock, never forecast output or unmanifested promises. Due
Food/energy holds guard discretionary production/labs/repair/military supply before
needs; separate hull/building reservations remain explicit. Four tiers are imminent
needs recovery, recovery, obligation and ordinary. Strict category0 gate is the
user-selected requirement; other numeric/coordination choices remain Proposed.
An actor's War candidate contains only its own objective/funding witness. Central
admission attaches the defender's objective from its own same-tick private phase7
capture before atomic War installation. Private defender selection affects only
that later outcome, not declarer inputs/identity/order. Only the installed public
objective is disclosed; authority/private audits retain exact capture bindings.
## Session, controls and projection interfaces
Keep version-specific Sessions. The root sandbox facade routes operations to
their matching Session; it does not expose an untyped mutable state union.
Read-only projection may normalize display values into entity references that
retain the authority discriminator and full identifier bytes. Entity selection
from one version can never be dispatched into another version's command builder.
Semantic actions carry resident ownership and draft/modal context exactly as
current Living input does. Switching versions retires queued input, clipboard
completion, audio cues, comparisons and transfer jobs belonging to the old
resident. Read-only selection/layers/audio never enqueue authority commands.
Inspectors show population trend/needs, industry inputs and blocked causes,
specialization/workforce, research funding/progress/unlocks, environmental
conditions/warnings, treaty terms/obligations and war objectives/readiness.
Omniscient facts and actor observations have distinct labels; observations show
source and timestamp. Decision explanations reference recorded candidates,
scores/rejections and facts rather than reconstructing a reason from final state.
Creator drafts preserve invalid intermediate text. Preview describes exact
before/after values, dependencies, cascades, refunds/dispositions and application
boundary. Free creator interventions remain distinct from actor-paid decisions.
Every new operation supports typed validation, atomic application, provenance,
undo/redo, exact history restoration and save/transfer.
## Library, storage and portable reproduction
Route files by explicit recognized top-level kind and version before constructing
an engine. Unknown versions fail visibly and preserve the resident document.
Exact V3 catalogs are required; matching a name is insufficient. Never use a V2
pack to interpret V3 state.
Store V3 slots/packs in a distinct namespace with generation CAS and neutral
Continue selection naming the exact authority/version, slot, branch and view.
Extend the coordinator through a separately versioned record; old valid V1/V2
selections remain read-only fallback when the newer coordinator is absent.
An existing corrupt/errored newer record cannot silently fall back to selecting
another galaxy. Explicit recovery retains the preceding independently valid
generation and names what the user can recover.
V3 portable reproduction includes exact catalog, archive and Notebook evidence.
Import into a new slot after bounded validation/replay. Export owns one coherent
capture and checks freshness before each handoff. Native durable completion and
browser download handoff stay distinct. Cancellation racing a won commit must
report actual durability and reconcile selection rather than claim no mutation.
Notebook references include exact domain, branch, revision, tick, state/receipt
digest and event identity. Validation replays the selected history. Comparing
different rules versions is out of scope; a V3 experiment compares retained V3
branches at one tick and reports measured differences without universal causal
claims.
## Acceptance and review package
Require independently derived V3 canonical vectors, invalid/unknown/truncated
files, duplicate/dangling IDs, stale/cancelled jobs, arithmetic/capacity failure,
simultaneous scarcity, hidden/stale intelligence, lifecycle/capture/removal and
complete creator cascades. Compare uninterrupted, saved/replayed and transferred
results; vary poll budgets and render cadences without changing digests.
Each subsystem includes deterministic content witnesses, ordinary visible and
semantic operation, evidence-backed experiment, save/Continue and export/import.
Repeat native/WebGPU/WebGL2/accessibility/offline/endurance/performance acceptance
for exact artifacts. No proposed mechanic becomes Current merely because its
state type or unit test exists.
Written review must settle: independent V3 crate and no automatic migration;
coordinator compatibility; exact resource/clock interactions; population and
research limits; ecological schedules; treaty obligations/intelligence; objective
resolution and logistics. These are the next focused specification deliverables,
not implementation choices delegated to an agent.
## Integrated review corrections, 2026-10-02
Known environmental forecasts require exact observed event targets, intervals,
creator-edited factors and original observer/timestamp; their bounded visibility
records are schema correction I1, not permission to scan hidden root schedules.
Snapshot, audit, utility and creator-order semantics follow schema corrections
I2–I5/scoring; coordinator reads enforce derived504-byte cap before parse (I6).
These changes are Proposed, preserve V2 separation, and require new integrated
vector/qualification evidence rather than relabelling baseline subset success.
## Integrated round2 environmental scope correction (Proposed)
Complete-schema §Integrated correction I1 is the normative environmental knowledge
registry. Complete timestamped system/lane assertions include empty negative
coverage; choose newest scope across all permitted source worlds before flattening
positive event IDs. Select newest per-event child over retained winning positives
INCLUDING expired children, then filter the chosen child by expiry, then check128-
fact capture limits; never resurrect a losing older copy on expiry. Scope history
is unchanged by filtering; source refresh/eviction is separate knowledge loss. Equal ticks use lowest
original observer then canonical scope bytes, without own-source priority. Missing,
partial or unrelated scope data grants no absence evidence. Shared/request copies
preserve scope bytes and timestamps. Forecasts use only winning permitted scopes;
hidden cancellations retain stale facts until authorized supersession or expiry.
Fresh schedule observation requires an incident directly visible world; own fleet
traversal alone does not refresh schedules. This explicitly Proposed visibility
refinement replaces round1's fleet-only read and changes observation/capture wire
bytes, not balance tables, combat sight or movement. Empty winners enter actor
snapshot hashes; complete observation carriers and scopes obey schema bounds.
Old-baseline corpora remain historical, and full integrated gap6 remains Partial.
# Living V3 society rules
Date: 2026-10-03. Status: **PROPOSED coordinated review submission2; independent integrated review, fresh complete vectors and human approval pending**.
Parent: `2026-10-01-living-expansion-architecture.md`.
These values are proposed balance choices, not implemented or accepted V2 rules.
## State and limits
Each colony stores population, specialization, its next needs boundary, latest
demographic outcome and workforce assignments. Food belongs to the world
inventory; needs, recipes and freight all debit that single canonical account. Shared planning,
central reservations and guarded due spending follow scoring §§1–8 and the
complete-schema §§Integrated planning/admission and scoring payloads.
Habitation capacity is derived from completed owned facilities and ecology, not
stored as a second independently editable total. Population is an aggregate integer count, 0..=10000; no individual
person entities exist. Food storage is 0..=10000, alongside local energy/ore/alloy.
Population and food are canonical state, never inferred from presentation.
Each civilization stores one optional research target, progress by technology
and an ordered set of completed catalog technologies. One actor can research one
technology at a time. Colony specialization is Balanced, Agrarian, Industrial or
Research. These choices are policy priorities, not free yield bonuses.
Retain 512 worlds and 16 civilizations as initial V3 topology limits. Use eight
industrial slots per colony, counting completed facilities and paid construction reservations;
global facilities remain capped at 2048. Changing limits requires versioned rules.
Ownership transfer preserves local population/food/infrastructure and clears the
old owner's assignments. Research belongs to the civilization and is not captured
with a colony. Removal disposes population explicitly in the creator cascade;
it cannot silently teleport to another world. Population zero is a nonterminal
colony state and does not by itself erase a civilization's ownership.
## Needs, growth and workforce

RecipeFacts records actual positive debits/outputs, with the sole authenticated Farm Food0 exception in complete-schema §ResourceAmount domains and empty-list meanings. For a due applicable Farm: checked clock, ordinary disabled branch, committed worker, then environment; q0 reports only environmental_limit with Food0 and no funding/storage/needs read. Positive q collects complete physical blockers before the due-needs guard. No lab/research point is a material ResourceAmount output. Strict recovery preserves every baseline funded imminent Food/energy payment at all own colonies under the conditional B/F operator, and central same-actor overlay rechecks prior costs. Optional bootstrap leaves last_needs=null even population0, status Active iff colony exists and first needs/environment clocks100; it runs no Needs payment or actor action.
Needs are due every100 ticks. Before phase5 discretionary input debits on a due
boundary, hold actual local Food/energy for the due phase6 population. Guarded
stock is held, not absent: non-life-support recipes/labs/repair/fleet supply may
spend only unheld stock. A held-energy Food recipe may execute only when its
atomic result strictly lowers combined imminent exposure and neither previously
fully funded resource becomes short. Report NeedsReserved separately from actual
MissingInput; denial consumes no input and obeys existing blocked-clock rules.
Complete-schema §Integrated planning and admission defines entry/recomputation/
release and exact guard facts. The holds do not change need quantities or clocks.
At phase6 use population at phase entry:
Food need = ceil(population/100); energy need = ceil(population/200). Zero
population needs zero. Debit each resource by min(available, need), record the
two actual shortages and advance the clock even when blocked. No negative
inventory, cross-world invisible payment or delayed catch-up consumption exists.
After needs, carrying capacity is min(10000, 1000 + 1000 * completed habitation
facilities), adjusted by the ecology specification. When both needs were fully
paid and population is below effective capacity, compute proposed growth as
min(capacity-population, max(1, floor(population/100))). Apply it only when
remaining Food >= ceil((population + proposed growth)/100), the next-boundary
need of the resulting population. Otherwise remain steady unless another decline
cause applies. Population zero does not grow spontaneously.
Otherwise, an unmet need or population above capacity reduces population by
min(population, max(1, ceil(population/100))). Population at capacity with paid
needs remains unchanged. Record growth/decline/steady with the actual causes.
One worker unit is available per 100 population at the needs boundary. Each
enabled industrial facility requires one unit to operate; completed habitation
does not. Hub baseline remains unstaffed so a declining colony can recover.
Assign workers after demographics. Existing paid construction/repair is not
cancelled solely by a workforce shortage. An unstaffed recipe advances its clock
and reports Workforce unavailable without consuming inputs.
Assignment priority groups:
| Specialization | First | Second | Third | Last |
| Balanced | Food/power | Extraction/processing | Research | Military industry |
| Agrarian | Food | Power | Extraction/processing | Research/military |
| Industrial | Power | Extraction/processing | Food | Research/military |
| Research | Food/power | Research | Extraction/processing | Military industry |
Within a group use facility ID order. Defense and habitation are passive;
shipyard counts as military industry. Jobs complete independently of assignment,
but an unstaffed shipyard cannot accept a new autonomous hull job. Creator
overrides may set specialization/population/food but do not bypass structural
capacity; their preview includes changed assignments and needs.
## Added catalog definitions
| Facility | Alloy cost | Build ticks | Operation |
| Habitation | 30 | 150 | Adds 1000 base carrying capacity; passive |
| Farm | 30 | 150 | Every 10 ticks, 2 energy produces 20 Food; one worker |
| Research lab | 60 | 300 | Every 20 ticks, 2 energy + 1 alloy produces 1 research point; one worker |
Recipes are atomic: all required inputs/output room/assignment must exist or
consume nothing. First operation is completion plus period. Farms require a
habitable owned colony. Ecology adjusts renewable Food output using integer
basis points; exact multiplication and flooring are in its specification.
Food freight follows the same explicit local route, batch, reserve, transit and
ownership permission model as other resources. Accepted shipment quantities are
immutable while travelling.
## Research
The initial finite catalog graph is:
| Technology | Prerequisite | Points | Effect |
| Agronomy | None | 100 | Farm base Food output becomes 25 instead of 20 |

| Resilient habitation | Agronomy | 150 | Ecology §World environment and conservation Formula A: Cbase-floor((Cbase-Cnormal)/2); capacity-only penalty reduction, base habitability remains the capacity limit; e and Farm Food unchanged |
| Efficient logistics | None | 100 | Actor-funded departure cost multiplied by3/4 PER HULL, ceiling/minimum1 then checked sum; already paid motion unchanged |
Research has no effect before completion. For labs due on one boundary, process
stable ID order. A lab pays only if its owner has an eligible selected target, progress is below
cost, staff/inputs/output conditions hold and the due-needs guard permits its
local debit. Physically present held energy cannot be spent by the lab. On reaching cost, emit completion, mark the technology
complete and clear the target; later labs that boundary do not pay for an absent
target. Do not credit excess points to a new target automatically.
Changing targets preserves progress in a per-technology ordered record rather
than refunding inputs. Creator grant/revoke/target changes are explicit history
operations. Revocation names downstream completed technologies and target
dependencies; an incomplete cascade rejects atomically. Existing travelling
fleet payments are not recalculated after a technology change.
Autonomous research target selection runs at the actor decision boundary from
its permitted snapshot: select an incomplete eligible technology by policy
priority, then slug. Trader prioritizes Efficient logistics; Guardian prioritizes
Resilient habitation through Agronomy; Neutral/Expansionist prioritize Agronomy,
then Efficient logistics, then Resilient habitation. Industrialist uses the same
Neutral order. Scoring §4 specifies every eligible target priority/score exactly. Material utility
uses tagged economy components; every raw numeric field has a fixed PolicyScore
reason order. Eligible-only trace excludes unfunded/unstaffed/unformed alternatives;
central scarcity denial is recorded separately under schema correction I4.
Selection reserves no phantom
resources; actual labs pay locally when due.
## Autonomous economy and settlement
Add explicit candidates for Food production, habitation, staffing-support power
and research. Needs recovery is a hard priority above discretionary
growth/research/military spending; policy ranks candidates within that priority
and cannot trade imminent Food/energy recovery for discretionary goals. This
priority was selected by the user on2026-10-02. Exact Proposed within-priority
utility, policy bonuses, forecast horizons, imminent<=100 category predicate,
obligation tier and deterministic tie/merge order are scoring §§1–8. Reduce an
actual imminent owned needs outcome to qualify category0; later-only benefit is
category1. The separately declared public Food/energy request opportunity exception
never counts promised freight as exposure saved. Phase8/9 share one post-phase7
permitted capture. Forecast includes owned local state and actual known immutable
incoming manifests, not unmanifested contracted promises or private rival stock.
Central guards/paid accounts and candidate costs use the same exact terms.
Candidate identity is full canonical action plus AdmissionTerms; batch/fleet/
force alternatives are distinct. Category0 precedes all discretionary spending,
then recovery, obligation and ordinary follow the exact shared ledger ordering.
Every Hull has required Passengers{count:u32,voyage_origin:Option<WorldID>}.
Non-Ark requires count0/origin null; count0 clears origin. Per-Ark physical maximum
is explicitly u32::MAX, a NEW Proposed capacity recommendation, with checked
addition/transfer and separate Colony population/effective capacity. There is no
invented narrower passenger-full denial or Catalog capacity field. A reached
Board addition overflow is a whole unpublished Arithmetic fault, not omission or
capacity Decision; earlier actual guard precedence remains intact.
Autonomous Board transfers exactly100 from actual owned origin Colony population
at least200 to exact Ark, with immediate workforce recomputation. Preserve origin
Some or null; boarding/refuel/order/split/merge never substitutes present World for
voyage origin. A first genuine positive-passenger NONRETURN departure with null
origin installs actual departure World; Return never creates it. Some persists
through later motion/reorganization/ownership changes until count0 or explicit
creator cohort reset/deletion. Creator CreateHull uses count-only input and origin
null; SetPassengers override starts the submitted count with origin null, never
claims actor-paid provenance. World deletion clears matching origin while preserving
people under exact reviewed closure, not nearest-origin substitution.
Emit intent_decided then passengers_boarded then one operation_changed containing
complete Fleet AND Colony Changes with
passenger_delta+100/−100/resources[], workforce_changed iff assignments changed.
These describe ONE transfer, never duplicate debit. Genuine phase3 pre-arrival
Return unloads only Hulls whose original origin equals endpoint and current Fleet
owner equals live matching Colony owner. Transfer min(count, max(effectiveCapacity−
population,0)) in Hull-ID order; zero emits nothing/no stationary retry. Positive
emits passengers_unloaded owning the population transfer, then one
operation_changed with complete containing Fleet Change only (delta−unloaded
count/resources[]), then workforce_changed iff assignments changed. No duplicate
Colony Change repeats that transfer;
remaining people stay aboard with their original origin. Count reaching0 clears it.
No Food/Energy/Needs clock, demographic growth or new credit occurs on transfer.
Founding consumes only lowest globally eligible Hull ID among winning civilization's
actual closing-member Arks; Fleet ID is not first tie. Transfer its exact count P
to new Colony once, removing containing Fleet iff last Hull. P must fit the existing Colony
population domain and structural admission predicates; never truncate people. Other Arks retain counts/credits.
Primary settlement_claim_resolved has full conserved Fleet−P/Colony+P Changes;
passengers_unloaded iffP>0 has absent prior population=null, newSome(P), not fake0.
No hull_destroyed/passengers_lost on settlement. Genuine combat/creator destruction
records passenger loss once; captured Hull ownership changes faction with people,
never resets their original voyage proof. Last-Hull creator removal uses reviewed
containing-Fleet destruction/job occupancy closure, not an empty Fleet or combat
half-refund convention. All exact source/capture/Changes are retained in history.
## Creator, explanation and evidence
Add typed population/Food/specialization/research edits, habitation/farm/lab
creation and passenger boarding/disposition operations. Preview shows exact
dependencies, workforce, needs, capacity and downstream technology cascades.
Actor-paid operations and free creator changes remain separately receipted.
Expose needs paid/shortfall, growth cause, workforce assignment, operation state,
research target/progress/funding and completed technologies in visible/semantic
inspectors. No green Enabled badge substitutes for actual operating conditions.
Tests must cover population 0/1/99/100/199/200/10000; Food/energy shortages
independently and together; exact capacity; disabled/unstaffed/overflow recipes;
simultaneous labs completing one target; target switching; technology cascades;
boarding/return/capture/destruction conservation; scarcity reservations; hidden
rival inventory; poll budgets; undo/replay/save/transfer. Independent wire vectors
must include the new fields/events before this Proposed contract becomes code.
For known freight recovery forecasts use only timestamped observed lane/stellar
interval/factor records in the permitted payload, never hidden root hazards or
unannounced schedule changes. Actor-only trace digest excludes hidden authority
State/revision provenance while the full outer audit remains replay-authenticated.
Required fixtures include simultaneous staff/funds failure (no trace record),
absent path/unobserved target (no record), every viable full-slot scrap replacement,
and central conflict denial with unchanged trace count/hash.

partial or unrelated scope data grants no absence evidence. Shared/request copies
preserve scope bytes and timestamps. Forecasts use only winning permitted scopes;
hidden cancellations retain stale facts until authorized supersession or expiry.
Fresh schedule observation requires an incident directly visible world; own fleet

## World environment and conservation
Each world stores base habitability, environmental stress, renewable fertility,
maximum fertility and a renewal/decay next-due clock. Values use integer basis
points, 0..=10000. maximum fertility is immutable catalog/genesis data unless an
explicit creator edit changes it with a complete preview. Current fertility may
not exceed maximum. There is no floating-point environment state.
At the world's ecology boundary, every 100 ticks: renew fertility by min(50,
maximum-current) and reduce stress by min(10, stress). Advance next_due by exactly
100, even at either bound. There is no catch-up renewal after pause or import.
Finite mineral deposits do not replenish through this rule.
Effective habitability and carrying capacity use checked integer intermediates,
with no floating point. Let completed_habitation_count count completed habitation:
```text
C = min(10000, 1000 + 1000 * completed_habitation_count)
b = base_habitability
p = floor(stress/2) + min(10000, summed_active_habitability_impacts)
e = max(0, b - p)
Cbase = floor(C * b / 10000)
Cnormal = floor(C * e / 10000)
D = Cbase - Cnormal
Cresilient = Cbase - floor(D / 2)
Formula A above is the explicit Proposed capacity-only recommendation, closing
rounding order for review; it is not previously human-approved or entailed by
“penalty halved.” Effective capacity is Cnormal without completed Resilient
habitation and Cresilient with it. Only integer capacity penalty D is scaled by
carrying_capacity_penalty_scale with literal numerator1/denominator2; completion never changes e or Farm Food.
Base habitability remains a capacity limit after completion: no environment
(e=b) gives Cbase, and b=0 gives capacity0. Compute subtraction/clamping without
unsigned underflow; multiplication, summation and all other intermediates are checked.
Human-approval preparation must disclose alternative capacity-only Formula B:
Dalt=floor(C*(b-e)/10000), Cresilient_alt=Cbase-floor(Dalt/2).
At C=1000,b=20,stress=22,no impacts, p=11,e=9,Cbase=2,Cnormal=0;
A gives D=2/capacity1, B gives Dalt=1/capacity2. Neither changes Farm Food.
A is the proposed numerical selection for the corrected package, not human
approval or an implementation release; complete package human approval remains pending.
Farm Food output = floor(base recipe output * effective habitability / 10000),
then limited by renewable fertility. Each actual Food unit consumes one fertility
unit. The schema Farm evaluated prefix checks staffing before environment; a
staffed q0 consumes no energy and reports only Environmental limit/Food0. Positive
q physical blockers precede needs holds; failed input/room/worker consumes neither
energy nor fertility. Farms run in stable facility-ID order and cannot spend fertility twice.
Agronomy changes only the base output, before environmental scaling.
Actual successful extractor operation adds 1 stress; successful foundry operation
adds 2 stress. Blocked attempts add zero. Apply stress immediately, capped at
10000; it can affect later ID-ordered farms on the same production boundary.
This order is normative and must be shown in operation/forecast explanations.
Other existing recipes add zero unless a new catalog definition explicitly names
a stress contribution in a later reviewed rules version.
The world inspector distinguishes mineral remaining, renewable fertility,
renewal rate, stress/decay, effective habitability, capacity and active events.
Do not label a finite deposit as renewable or present nominal recipe output as
actual achievable output.
## Stellar activity and disasters
Initial automatic event: Solar flare. Each star stores its next activity boundary,
initialized to genesis +1000. At a due boundary E, independently derive
SHA256(domain literal `NYON_LIVING_V3_STELLAR_ACTIVITY`, seed32, star_id16,
E little-endian u64); interpret bytes 0..2 as little-endian u16. A value less than
6554 selects a flare. Advance the clock by1000 regardless of selection.
A selected flare receives an identity from the reviewed V3 autonomous entity
formula, using that star, E and its stable activity ordinal. It targets the star's
system, warns at E, starts at E+100 and ends at E+200, end-exclusive. Active flare
impact is 2000 habitability basis points on that system's worlds and a 1/2
freight batch multiplier on lanes with that system as an endpoint, rounding down.
The existing ion-storm lane event is a separate type; concurrent modifiers apply
in event-ID order to the current integer batch. No hidden ambient RNG or wall
clock influences activity.
Hazards and stellar_events each have at most128 pending/active records, separately.
Automatic star creation checks only stellar_events occupancy128;128 hazards do not
consume a stellar slot. At stellar capacity, reject automatic event creation with an explicit capacity-omission event while advancing
the activity clock; do not fail unrelated world updates or overwrite an existing
event. The omission fact names star/E/proposed type, so replay reproduces it.
Expired records remain in history receipts and leave active state at expiry.
Creator may schedule/edit/cancel a flare or supported lane hazard, including
exact target and warning/start/end boundaries. Validation enforces warning <=
start < end and rejects missing targets, overflow and duplicate identities
atomically. An event already active can be cancelled only as an explicit creator
revision with its boundary and changed effects recorded.
## Autonomous adaptation

Actor32 selects exact owned deposits, public World id/system and own claims/occupation records, while remote dynamic inputs remain observed. Scoring §Conditional private B/F operator holds unsupported claim/combat/storage effects and never reads seed for ranks/flare foresight. Complete-schema §Closed scale domains permits Proposed creator nonamplifying0..denominator/positive denominator, retaining unreduced spelling; automatic flares and fixed Catalog stay literal1/2. Exact zero-freight transition scales nominal batch after blockade and before stock cap; zero issues no Shipment/debit/delivery credit and never bypasses earlier source floor. Optional bootstrap is schema B0–B7, not a global richer-Genesis ban.
Actors know environmental data only for currently visible worlds/lanes or their
timestamped prior observations. Their snapshot's known_hazards and
known_stellar_events carry exact observed lane/system/star target, warning/start/
end, freight fraction and original observer/tick (schema correction I1). Warnings
become observable only with warning<=capture tick<end and authorized direct/shared
visibility; knowing distant topology alone grants no live schedule. Captured stale
facts survive unseen edits until refreshed and remain labelled counterfactual.
Apply captured freight factors in event-ID order; never hard-code1/2 for a
creator-edited fraction or read hidden root event placement. No star RNG clock or
seed is revealed by these records. Their scheduled forecasts apply known warnings,
habitat penalties, needs and actual known immutable manifests; unmanifested
contracted promises never count as arrivals. They cannot read unseen changes or
future seeded disasters before warning. Scoring §§1–8 fixes their exact200-boundary
counterfactual, visibility, checked utility and complete admission/tie ordering.
Adaptation candidates use existing economic/fleet reservation lanes: add staffing
and Food production, fund resilience research, increase habitation, adjust supply
or move/settle through an eligible ark. Imminent paid-needs shortage outranks
discretionary construction. Qualifying category0 reduces an owned needs result
within100 ticks (or the explicitly declared public-request opportunity); helping
only later needs is recovery category1. Adaptation shares the same physical/
industrial/hull/fleet reservations as diplomacy and economy. Due production obeys
the society guard before phase6; actual stress/fertility effects still use the
unchanged ID/atomic recipe order. Research is a gradual investment, not an emergency
instant unlock. Passengers obey society conservation; no free evacuation population
or globally teleported supply is introduced.
## Creator/history and acceptance
Typed environment edits expose base values, actual fertility, stress and clocks.
Previews show affected worlds/routes/needs/workforce and ownership-independent
impacts. Creator overrides are free but cannot bypass ranges, identity or capacity.
Hazard layer and text warnings expose the same facts as semantics and Chronicle.
Pin boundary E/E+99/E+100/E+199/E+200, multiple stars, equal-ID ordering,
concurrent flare/ion storm, empty galaxies, zero/full fertility, depleted minerals,
stress caps, Food/storage atomicity, actor-hidden changes, event capacity omission,
creator cancellation/removal and undo/replay. Derive activity/hash fixtures outside
the Rust implementation. Save immediately before a warning/start/end and compare
next results to uninterrupted authority; test native/wasm and polling parity.
Independent correction fixtures must compare announced versus hidden/cancelled/
expired/creator-edited records, conflicting provenance, exact system/lane freight
targets, multiple factor ID order and equal permitted input with different hidden
root changes. Eligible trace omission/clock/cost handling follows schema I4.
These written contracts do not imply those future vectors already exist.
## Integrated round2 environmental scope correction (Proposed)
Complete-schema §Integrated correction I1 is the normative environmental knowledge
registry. Complete timestamped system/lane assertions include empty negative
coverage; choose newest scope across all permitted source worlds before flattening
positive event IDs. Select newest per-event child over retained winning positives
INCLUDING expired children, then filter the chosen child by expiry, then check128-
fact capture limits; never resurrect a losing older copy on expiry. Scope history
is unchanged by filtering; source refresh/eviction is separate knowledge loss. Equal ticks use lowest
original observer then canonical scope bytes, without own-source priority. Missing,
partial or unrelated scope data grants no absence evidence. Shared/request copies
preserve scope bytes and timestamps. Forecasts use only winning permitted scopes;
hidden cancellations retain stale facts until authorized supersession or expiry.
Fresh schedule observation requires an incident directly visible world; own fleet
traversal alone does not refresh schedules. This explicitly Proposed visibility
refinement replaces round1's fleet-only read and changes observation/capture wire
bytes, not balance tables, combat sight or movement. Empty winners enter actor
snapshot hashes; complete observation carriers and scopes obey schema bounds.
Old-baseline corpora remain historical, and full integrated gap6 remains Partial.

## Offers and negotiated terms
Retain directed integer relations and limited observations. Add offers with exact
proposer/recipient, kind, terms, creation/expiry tick and identity. Offer kinds are
Transit access, Resource supply and Mutual defense. A civilization has at most
one outgoing pending offer; global pending capacity is64. Propose/accept/refuse
only at the100-tick diplomacy boundary using the immutable post-phase7 permitted
planning capture shared with phase9. Central admission protects category0 plans
before older pending-offer consideration; responses then use recipient-ID/offer-ID
order against leftover capacity. New terms do not recapture/rescore actor plans. New offers
are first considered at the next such boundary, never accepted immediately.
Offers expire at creation+300, end-exclusive. A refusal/expiry removes the pending
record and emits its exact reason. Missing/captured endpoint or participant,
incompatible war and exhausted obligations capacity make acceptance impossible;
they cannot alter a partially committed treaty or debit resources.
Acceptance rules:
| Offer | Eligibility | Terms |

| Transit access | Both directed relations >=0; no war/truce; connected participants | Reciprocal nonoffensive entry to participant-owned Worlds for1200 ticks; public System/Lane transit needs no treaty; no ownership or resource grant |
| Resource supply | Both relations >=0; eligible direct route; recipient known demand | One exact source/destination/resource route, batch1..10, cadence10, source reserve >=20; duration1200 |
| Mutual defense | Both relations >=40; no war/truce; connected participants | Reciprocal defense-request obligation for1200 ticks; no implicit offensive war or omniscient intelligence |
Resource supply's sender may use only stock above its own known next-needs reserve
and treaty route reserve; inability to dispatch creates an obligation wait fact,
not invented cargo. A later capture, war or capacity denial can suspend fulfillment
without changing previously dispatched manifest ownership/quantities.
The shared256 treaty account is exactly actual Agreement keys UNION derived
future Truce keys of retained Wars, plus distinct Commitment IDs; completed/import
State and projected creator prefixes obey the schema union/temporal predicates.
At capacity, offers remain pending until expiry with Capacity unavailable reason.
Autonomous material offers first obey scoring's exact category/deadline gates,
then integer utility, kind (Supply, Access, Defense), target and counterpart;
proposer/full identity break final ties. Supply's target is destination_world;
Access/Defense Terms name parties only and therefore their optional target is
absent. No phantom world is added to an offer solely for tie-breaking. Global merge is exactly scoring §7;
no second actor-first offer comparator applies. Supply utility is100 times the proposed
batch plus the minimum bilateral relation; it requires an explicit recipient
demand request, not access to its inventory. Access utility is100 times the count
of observed unowned worlds reachable through the proposed access, plus minimum
relation. Defense utility is100 times observed threatened owned worlds plus
minimum relation. Policy bonuses: Trader Supply1000/Access500; Guardian
Defense1000; Neutral Access500; Expansionist Access1000/Supply500; Industrialist
uses Neutral's Access500 and otherwise0. These remain Proposed weights. Clamp relation
contribution to0..100 and world counts to512. Evaluate all legal complete candidates from
the snapshot and reserve exact terms centrally. Offer Candidate uses the exact
ScoreComponents.offer mapping: Supply batch, Access reachable_worlds, Defense
threatened_worlds, other count fields0; min_relation/policy_bonus always explicit.
War/defender components use their exact objective-kind fields/zero rules, null
force travel0. Eligible-only trace and separate fixed central-denial reason order
are schema correction I4; utility weights are unchanged. Demand requests
carry actor/world/resource/units/tick and expire after200 ticks; the receiver
posts only its own shortage. Never disclose the receiver's complete stockpile.
Renewal requires mutual eligibility at a diplomacy boundary; never automatic
extension. Creator may set relations, create/remove exact commitments or cancel
offers through explicit revisions and complete incompatibility previews.
## Inherited free Trade/Nonaggression handshake
These two legacy kinds are free bilateral protocol, NOT new three-kind Offers,
material Candidate/Trace/attempt or diplomacy lane fills. H follows older OffersO
and precedes PeaceK/remainingM. Freeze unordered H7 Active pairs a<b, max120;
consider Trade then Nonaggression. Both original actor inputs must independently
prove bilateral relations: Trade>=0 plus some valid own-Colony public graph
connection; Nonaggression>=20 with NO connection requirement. Same System suffices;
otherwise real public graph path. Missing Relation is exact source-defined0, not
foreign account access. Both captures remain full phase7 and do not leak to peer.
Retained same-kind Agreement, any retained same-pair War including future, or active
Truce excludes captured attempt; current gain cannot create a new H7 proposal.
For captured-eligible group revalidate current participants Active/references;
no retained same-kind key; no retained War then no active Truce; both actual totals;
Trade-only current valid Colony connection (alternate current own Colony pair may
replace removed captured witness); treaty union slot; checked T+1200 and output.
This is the exact free first-cause order. Old captured witness remains original
H7 historical proof, so its removal alone is not reference_missing if current
connection exists. Actual failure emits two rejected Decisions with one actual
cause each, no Agreement. Capacity uses admission_capacity agreements_commitments,
actor subject, limit256/reserved currentN; threshold uses each direction's actual
BilateralThreshold. No connection uses path_unavailable. Current gains never rescore.
Success installs exact Agreement kind/a/b/startT/endchecked(T+1200), no ID/AUTO,
resources, Relation credit, objective or witness. Group: a intent_decided, b
intent_decided, agreement_formed full one-key null→new Change/resources[]/delta0.
Each free Decision phase8/candidate null/score0/tierordinary/targetSome(peer)/
observed_ticknull/original H7/actionexactkind; success reasons BilateralThreshold
then Accepted mutual_trade_with_connection|mutual_nonaggression. Current guard
facts do not claim recomputed material utility. Failure has exact one reason.
Actor/phase8 Decision ordinal includes earlier real free/material Decisions; H
fills no lane and emits no CandidateAudit entry. Change actor-null source is real
full pre-pair current prefix. No self Receipt/Event source.
Active/future same-kind keys are never extended/replaced. Actual phase2 expiry
removes once; at next100 H can mutually REFORM after fresh eligibility, with real
off-grid gap and no backdated rights. Trade/Nonaggression/Truce keys cannot coexist
with ANY retained same-pair War, even future. Autonomous War cannot delete them:
actual H can block laterM, real category0R War blocks H. Creator ForceWar explicitly
removes every same-pair legacy key in reviewed closure then installs/replaces War,
counts future Truce once and executes active-now C/Request/order causes only if
start<=T. Future install leaves current C rights until genuine phase2 crossing.
Reciprocal creator SetAgreement explicitly removes same-pair War/bound invalid
orders/Blockades before installation/recovery; no silent future lease theft or
restoration of old legacy keys. Continuing C has independent ID/rights/capacity.
## Alliance intelligence and obligations
Mutual defense commitments form bilateral alliances; do not create transitive
alliances or automatic coalitions. An ally can request defense for one currently
owned threatened world it actually observes. One outstanding defense request per
commitment, cap256. Requests expire after200 ticks or when the threat/ownership
ceases. Sending records exact known enemy/target/timestamp and provenance.
The recipient can plan relief/defense without joining an offensive war silently.
If hostile action would require a declaration, produce a proposal subject to the
normal war admission rules and recorded refusal/acceptance. Existing third-party
commitments and own emergency needs take precedence; an unmet obligation remains
visible. No resource, hull or treaty can be reserved twice.
Intelligence sharing is limited to the exact requested target's observation.
Retain originating observer, observed tick and received tick. Receiving stale data
does not refresh its observed tick. For ordinary world facts own newer observations
win; equal-tick conflicts resolve by original observer ID. Environmental scope
assertions instead use the global per-scope selection in schema correction I1,
before world projection; contradictory provenance remains inspectable.
Sharing never copies private rival stockpiles or the whole omniscient galaxy.
## War objectives and resolution

War admission/root/queue validation derives the shared treaty account N=|AgreementKeys UNION FutureTruceKeys(Wars)|+|CommitmentIDs|<=256. No persistent lease field or fake Agreement exists. Exact creator overrides, generic removal cancellation, same-key past/touch/future Truce intervals and future-end/inherited phase1 exception are complete-schema §Derived future Truce capacity and mutation contract. Natural deadline phase2 or accepted peace actualE converts one reserved key to Truce[E,E+300) atomically; hidden capacity cannot block it. Autonomous declaration retains stage3 compatibility before capacity7, exact reserved=N_before and existing closed reasons; no legal121st pair exists under16 civs.
Add one primary objective to each war declaration:
- **Defend:** named owned world under observed hostile threat; success when no
hostile force/occupation is present at three consecutive diplomacy boundaries.
- **Secure access:** named direct lane corridor; success when valid negotiated
access exists or both corridor endpoints are owned by the declarer at three
consecutive diplomacy boundaries.
- **Occupy:** named observed enemy world; success after completed ownership capture
persists through the next diplomacy boundary.
Loss of the named reference invalidates the objective with an explicit result;
no replacement target is selected invisibly. A declaration still requires an
assembled reachable funded force, valid observations and treaty compatibility.
Defend outranks Secure access, which outranks Occupy; policy utility and stable
target ID break ties within a class; exact within-class formulas, force/endpoint/
path enumeration and ties are scoring §5. A candidate binds one whole eligible
idle fleet, complete sorted live hulls, departure world, arrival endpoint, selected
path and local departure-funding witness. Declaration reserves that force/account
transiently until publication but pays0 and starts no travel; later movement
revalidates current eligibility and pays once at actual departure. Record every
chosen/rejected candidate with complete AdmissionTerms and authenticated audits.
The declarer's War action/identity contains only its peer and own objective/force
terms. Central admission then selects the defender objective under the defender's
immutable same-tick phase7 capture, using the exact private objective/force ranking.
No valid defender objective rejects the unchanged attempted candidate and releases
its holds. A valid defender objective with no achievable force records null force
and force_unachievable; no fleet is invented. Attach both objectives atomically
before War publication. Only successful installation publicly discloses the
defender objective. Private defender force/accounts/capture contents remain in
defender-only audit projections; they never alter declarer enumeration/hash/ties.
WarAdmissionAudit binds that later selection to unchanged declarer identity. This
explicitly replaces the earlier actor-declaration two-objective requirement.
Creator ForceWar still supplies both objectives directly as a free override.
Objective terminal outcome can propose Peace, never unilateral conversion.
K freezes actual ascending War-pair roster and entry Peace per pair. Older
Proposed.created<T receives one response; none selects fresh terminal proposer,
refused selects eligible semantic-change retry, created==T receives no response.
Choose deterministic lower eligible proposer ID; newly refused never retries
in that same K pass. Genuine same-actor objective outcome
and original H7 classify achievable force TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN, never unknown defense0.
Terminal succeeded/invalid or proven FALSE accepts. TRUE with actual matching
eligible force refuses; TRUE blocked solely by actual strict recovery owner/holds
DEFERs unchanged. UNKNOWN DEFERs unchanged. No consideration tick/event is invented
for defer. A real refusal retains proposer/created, sets consideredT/statusrefused/
reasonobjective_still_achievable and emits one exact peace_refused; original full
Facts.peace record and installed reason must match. Natural expiry is phase2. War lasts1200 ticks;
peace/expiry converts its reserved key to a300-tick truce at actualE. Natural
expiry is phase2; completed/import War.end_tick>State.tick. A due inherited
phase1 row retains its reservation until exactly one conversion; new/replacement
ForceWar requires end>application and representable end+300. ForcePeace same-key
past intervals replace, touching/overlap coalesces and disjointfuture rejects
under schema; generic creator removal cancels its key without invented peace. For Occupy/Secure access, achievable means
one idle supplied reachable fleet's escort strength >=ceil(3*observed defense/2).
Escort strength is10 per live escort; observed defense is10 per observed defending
escort plus20 per operational battery. Attack observations must be no older than
300 ticks. Only own fleet HP/roles/supply and timestamped target observations enter
this comparison. Defend with a present threat remains achievable when such a fleet
can reach its owned target and has strength >=observed hostile escort strength;
no threat follows the explicit three-boundary success rule. War/truce and
occupation remain nonterminal; an empty or conquered galaxy stays editable.
Fresh Peace uses reasonobjective_complete or objective_invalid from actual terminal
outcome, proposed status/createdT/considerednull, one peace_proposed full installed
record. Existing Proposed is never overwritten. Refused retry compares genuine
semantic original refusal baseline: same objective instance, target observation
membership/strength/freshness class, actual original whole force/path/funding
eligibility. Ignore raw timestamp/receipt/pointer/evaluation transport refresh alone;
changed real predicate permits new proposal, no same-pass response. Actual War
end atomically removes War/order/Blockade/occupation consequences, forms reserved
Truce and exact continuing Request/Fleet/C groups, no fake universal two-event count.
Unknown source replay remains Pending/fault, not force_unachievable success.
Every genuine creator SetWarObjective resets the exact instance to pending/count0/
evaluatednull/witnessnull and clears Peace even byte-equal replacement. Creator
ForceWar constructs both sorted participant objectives reset likewise, peacenull,
checked end=start+1200, end>application and representable end+300. Pending Secure
submits exact live directional pair; other kinds null. No creator constructor may
submit arbitrary success/witness, borrow old samples or masquerade as negotiated
fulfillment. Paid location/Hulls/counts/credits stay intact under bound order cleanup.
## Fleet logistics and autonomous behavior
Ordinary paid Fleet motion is one origin-to-FINAL-World itinerary. A distinct
same-System target takes10 ticks with empty path; otherwise use minimum checked
sum of direct Lane durations max(10,ceil(distance_units/10)), tie by lexicographic
decoded Lane-ID sequence. Intermediate Systems/Lanes are public unowned graph
transit, with no docked waypoint, event, refuel, combat or continuation cursor.
Paid duration/path/roster/payment remains authenticated by its original departure
producer after future order edits. Later geometry, permissions or technology cannot
halt/reprice it. Actual required endpoint removal uses explicit reviewed traveller
relocation/destruction, never invented nearest placement, refund or fake credit.
At actual owned nonReturn launch each Hull pays base2 Energy plus2 iff missing
return_credit. Efficient Logistics applies ceil(3*base/4), minimum1, PER HULL,
then checked sum in Hull-ID order. Two credited Hulls therefore pay4, not aggregate
rounded3; this is an explicit NEW Proposed balance recommendation. Debit once,
grant each Hull credit once. Return/exact credited Dormant Ark recovery pays0 and
consumes every Hull credit once for the whole itinerary. Already paid travel never
pays again. Shipment's immutable original-duration return is a separate producer.
No global pool or forecast output funds a real departure.
Actual ownership comes from World.owner: own iff Some(actor), unowned iff null,
foreign iff Some(other actual issued participant). Colony absence never changes
that category. Separate OwnedColony requires matching World and Colony owner and
remains mandatory for Return/owned launch where prescribed. Missing World or nonnull wrong-kind/absent owner ID
is a typed fault; owner=null is legitimate unowned. Actor formation uses own full World records or its authorized
fresh ownership observations; absent/stale knowledge is UNKNOWN, not null.
Actual authority may deny from real current ownership without enriching H7 scores.
| Destination/order | Entry permission |
| Move/ordinary Explore | own/unowned allow; foreign requires active usable bilateral Transit |
| Pure-scout Explore | nonoffensive discovery entry to any live World without asserting owner/Transit |
| Settle | actual unowned target plus its own known habitability/Ark/claim purpose guards |
| Return | actual OwnedColony destination plus whole credits |
| Unbound Defend | actual own target plus its owning defense predicates |
| Request-bound Defend | exact accepted live original R/C/threat and requester-owned named target |
| Attack/Blockade | actual foreign enemy owner, active matching War and no active Truce |
Transit grants no offense, settlement, stock, intelligence or ownership. Trade,
Nonaggression, Supply, pending/future Transit and other Requests do not substitute.
An accepted original bound Defend authorizes only that named nonoffensive entry,
not generic allied Transit or declaration against its enemy. Required instance/
typed references are checked first, destination-purpose ownership second, public
topology third, then Truce-before-War offense or exact Transit/duty permission.
Each first failure carries its finite schema witness, not guessed rival data.
PureScoutRoster requires the entire nonempty whole Fleet to have scout-role Hulls,
count0 and voyage_origin null. It contains no idle/order/location/hold predicate.
H7 formation separately requires own Docked idle/funded/compatible whole Fleet and
public target/path, with objective/request null. Unknown destination ownership never
blocks that exact discovery family. Actual due Explore reuses current roster/kind/
null bindings, not order=null; structural holders do not revoke entry and block only
at their later guard. Changed mixed roster falls back to ordinary actual permission;
central scores/identity stay original and standing dispatch creates no Decision.
Discovery gives no combat immunity, occupation, cargo or offensive rights.
Attack/Blockade and travelling Defend require supplied. Move/Explore/Settle retain
nonoffensive travel eligibility without new military Supply requirement. Return,
exact Dormant credited recovery and already paid travel allow unsupplied. Stationary
own-world unbound Defend keeps its exception; this is no remote relief waiver.
Add a fleet supply record: last supplied tick, supplying world and supplies paid.
At an owned dock every100 ticks, one energy per hull funds supply through the next
100 ticks; pay atomically per fleet in fleet-ID order subject to the due Food/
energy hold. No funds or held-needs denial records an unavailable latest attempt
with paid0; a NeedsReserved fact distinguishes physically held stock from missing
inputs. Preserve any prior successful Supply payment and its deadline; supplied
readiness lasts until that deadline even if the latest attempt failed, then becomes
supply_unavailable. Record this attempt at the current global100-tick supply
boundary; the next such boundary applies without an invented Supply clock/payment.
Without eligible payment retain Supply history and retain existing travel/return eligibility. Unsupplied fleets cannot
accept a new offensive attack objective; they may return, defend their current
owned world or complete already-paid travel. This prevents midflight disappearance
or a hidden extra fuel debit.
Relief uses actual resource supply routes and manifests. Blockade is a due
hostile fleet's explicit order at an enemy route endpoint, not a camera effect.
An idle supplied hostile escort fleet docked at the source or destination restricts
new dispatch to floor(batch/2) only when its live escort strength (10 per escort)
is at least the endpoint's live defending escort strength plus20 per operational
battery. Require declared war with that endpoint owner. Apply this factor once
even with multiple eligible blockaders, before event-ID-ordered hazard factors.
Scale the nominal restricted batch in event-ID order BEFORE the above-floor
stock cap, under schema Exact zero-freight transition. Earlier clock/suspension/
participant/path/permission/P>max(reserve,next_need) funding guards decide first.
Funded restriction-zero emits route_attempted actual0/reason null, consumes no
Shipment slot/ID/stock and grants no delivery/fulfillment/recovery credit. A
positive attempt still obeys capacity and actual paid provenance. Transient
first-batch holds use the supported first eligible phase10 boundary d, never
acceptance-time suppression or guessed resume; new Route capacity remains
independent. Never delete or resize in-flight cargo. The restriction receipt records fleet,
endpoint, eligible/restricted batch and actual dispatched quantity.
Fleet intent reasons expose target, objective, route, known threat, supply state,
reservation and fallback. On invalidated targets, release future reservations
without refunding already consumed travel/recipe inputs; emit Return/Wait fallback
using actual local eligibility. Boarding/passenger fate follows society rules.
## Creator, persistence and acceptance
Add typed offer/terms/objective/supply edits and complete removal/capture cascades.
Preview incompatible agreements, war changes, requests, fleets/routes and actual
resource implications. Creator War effects are exactly aggregate creator Change
facts in original operation mutation order; no duplicate autonomous war_ended,
peace/paid supply or negotiated fulfillment credit is emitted. Free creator overrides never masquerade as paid logistics
or negotiated actor acceptance.
Inspectors/Chronicle show terms, expiry, fulfilled/waiting obligations, known
intelligence, objective progress and fleet readiness. History/Notebook preserve
exact offer/treaty/objective/receipt references. A war-alternative experiment names
its common parent, creator diplomatic change, matched ticks and actual outcomes.
Required fixtures: offer delays/expiry, asymmetric relations, no connection,
captured endpoints, simultaneous commitments, starvation versus promised supply,
bilateral/nontransitive alliances, stale/shared contradictory intelligence,
third-party treaty conflicts, absent/failed objectives, interrupted occupation,
supplied/unsupplied attack/return, blockade versus already-dispatched cargo,
reservation scarcity, creator cascades, replay/save/transfer and native/wasm parity.
Independent canonical vectors and the reviewed V3 state/command schema are still
required before implementation. These proposed utility, force, expiry and blockade
values are explicit balance decisions for written review; they are not V2 changes.
## Creator order and trace corrections
SetFleetOrder explicitly submits objective after lane_path. Null clears/replaces
old binding deterministically; cancellation has kind/target/objective null and
empty path. Nonnull ObjectiveKey must match actual fleet owner, existing War pair,
its pending objective and compatible order target/path. Full exact allowed-kind/
target semantics are schema I5. ForcePeace/removal cancels pair-bound orders and
Blockades without changing an already-paid travelling leg or refunding inputs.
Reviewed previews must show these exact before/after Fleet effects.
Candidate trace context omits hidden State/revision provenance, but the full outer
audit authenticates it. Private defender changes may change admission/outer receipt,
never equal-input declarer trace bytes/digest. Known environmental freight factors
come only from bounded observed records, including actual creator-edited values.
## Integrated round2 environmental scope correction (Proposed)
Complete-schema §Integrated correction I1 is the normative environmental knowledge
registry. Complete timestamped system/lane assertions include empty negative
coverage; choose newest scope across all permitted source worlds before flattening
positive event IDs. Select newest per-event child over retained winning positives
INCLUDING expired children, then filter the chosen child by expiry, then check128-
fact capture limits; never resurrect a losing older copy on expiry. Scope history
is unchanged by filtering; source refresh/eviction is separate knowledge loss. Equal ticks use lowest
original observer then canonical scope bytes, without own-source priority. Missing,
partial or unrelated scope data grants no absence evidence. Shared/request copies
preserve scope bytes and timestamps. Forecasts use only winning permitted scopes;
hidden cancellations retain stale facts until authorized supersession or expiry.
Fresh schedule observation requires an incident directly visible world; own fleet
traversal alone does not refresh schedules. This explicitly Proposed visibility
refinement replaces round1's fleet-only read and changes observation/capture wire
bytes, not balance tables, combat sight or movement. Empty winners enter actor
snapshot hashes; complete observation carriers and scopes obey schema bounds.
Old-baseline corpora remain historical, and full integrated gap6 remains Partial.
